item.title: EPL: Fulham get Chukwueze boost for Tottenham clash
item.description: Samuel Chukwueze is in contention to face Tottenham Hotspur in Sunday’s Premier League encounter. item.title: Power generation drops to 4,300MW as gas shortfall hampers thermal plants
item.description: Electricity generation in Nigeria has fallen to an average of 4,300 megawatts (MW) following a significant reduction in gas supply to thermal power stations, the Nigerian Independent System Operator, NISO, has disclosed. item.title: Lagos pensioners threaten mass protest over unpaid arrears
item.description: Lagos State Chairman of the Nigeria Union of Pensioners, Contributory Pension Scheme, NUPCPS, Comrade Michael Omisande, has warned that pensioners may stage a mass protest. item.title: Oyo fire agency recovers 27-year-old man from well in Ibadan
item.description: Oyo State Fire Service has recovered the body of a 27-year-old man from a well in Ibadan, the state capital. item.title: Naira records massive weekly depreciation against US Dollar in official, black markets
item.description: The naira recorded a significant weekly depreciation against the United States dollar across both the official and parallel foreign exchange markets on Friday.
